  • Classes in edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.services used by edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.services
    Class
    Description
    BibTexConverterService
    Converts between raw BibTeX text (as pasted by a user) and BibTexEntry documents, using JBibTeX for the actual BibTeX parsing/formatting.
    BibTexSynthesisService
    Builds a raw BibTeX string from a ResolvedWork, so it can be fed through the existing, already-tested BibTexConverterService.parseToEntries(java.lang.String, int) rather than hand-building a BibTexEntry and duplicating its validation/normalization.
    CitationGraphService
    Orchestrates the "Get References" and "Get Citations" jobs: looks up a source BibTexEntry's DOI across a chain of CitationMetadataResolvers (OpenAlex first, then Semantic Scholar, then Crossref), resolves the related works the first successful resolver names, synthesizes+saves a BibTexEntry for each one not already present (deduped by DOI), and records a CitationEdge between the source and each related entry.
    CitationMetadataResolver
    A source of scholarly-work metadata and citation-graph data (references/citations), e.g.
    CrossrefResolver
    Client for the Crossref REST API (https://api.crossref.org, no API key required), tried after OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar in the resolver chain — see docs/design/OpenAlex-MVP-to-full-tiered-fallback-engine.md.
    CurrentUserService
     
    DblpResolver
    Client for DBLP's public search API (https://dblp.org/search/publ/api, no API key required), tried last in the resolver chain — see docs/design/OpenAlex-MVP-to-full-tiered-fallback-engine.md and issue #66.
    DOIService
    Recognizes a DOI (Digital Object Identifier) expressed in any of several common formats and normalizes it to its canonical bare form (ANSI/NISO Z39.84), e.g.
    GoogleSignInService

    OpenAlexService
    Client for the OpenAlex API (https://api.openalex.org, no API key required), used to discover a paper's outgoing references and incoming citations.
    ResolvedWork
    A minimal, resolver-agnostic projection of a scholarly work, carrying only the fields BibTexSynthesisService needs to synthesize a BibTeX entry, plus enough of its reference/citation graph for CitationGraphService to discover related works without a second round-trip where a resolver's API already hands them over in the same response.
    SemanticScholarResolver
    Client for the Semantic Scholar Graph API (https://api.semanticscholar.org/graph/v1, an optional API key raises the rate limit — see docs/README_API_CONFIG.md), tried after OpenAlex in the resolver chain — see docs/design/OpenAlex-MVP-to-full-tiered-fallback-engine.md.
